verdict.rationale: Column offers reports (transactions, summaries) exportable in open CSV/JSON/Parquet formats and a documented OpenAPI spec enabling programmatic data retrieval, which supports data portability. However, there is no explicit documentation of a full data export or account-closure/migration process covering all data types (KYC records, statements, card data, etc.), so 'leaving' with all data is only partially evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit full-account data export/closure workflow, evidence of exporting non-report data (KYC, statements, card records), and independent confirmation of successful migrations.
